title: A counterexample to a global-dimension bound for weighted projective lines
summary: We observe that standard derived equivalences give a counterexample to a conjecture of Kalck on global dimension for weighted projective lines. For the root stack $X=\mathbb{P}^1\langle \infty,0,1;2,3,3\rangle$ we exhibit a $13$-dimensional radical-square-zero algebra $A$ such that $$ D^b(\mathrm{coh}X)\simeq D^b(\mathrm{mod}A), \qquad \mathrm{gldim}A=4>3. $$
